findings.defect: Initial context already contains alert digest, relevant topology and candidate/incident metadata while OBSERVE exposed overview, alert and topology operations.
findings.repair: Initial model-visible surface is HYPOTHESIZE or STOP; cheap observation packet remains harness-owned.
findings.test: initial surface regression and overlap report

findings.defect: EVENT_ANALYSIS was registered as GLOBAL although its executor accepts and uses a canonical entity filter.
findings.repair: EVENT_ANALYSIS is TARGET-scoped and available only in VERIFY for the current candidate.
findings.test: targeted event scope and per-candidate duplicate tests

findings.defect: Unrecognized operations fell through to available=true, so METRIC_ANOMALIES was exposed even when its bounded result had no useful candidate signal.
findings.repair: Metric availability is derived from candidate-filtered aggregate groups with an actual delta/relative-change signal.

findings.defect: Individual action, operation and target enums did not prevent cross-field combinations such as HYPOTHESIZE with an operation or INVESTIGATE on a non-current target.
findings.repair: Provider request schema uses action-specific anyOf branches and runtime validates the same branches.
